meta.description: Onboarding tour for first-time omo users

copy.tagline: 引导新用户快速熟悉产品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想为新用户提供友好的产品导览
copy.tagline_en: Guide new users through your product quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to offer a friendly product tour to first-time users

howto.what: Claude 会化身为新用户与 omo 首场对话的引导员,依次走完功能导览、迁移帮助、历史会话挖掘、价值估算、记忆记录与 init-deep 提案六个环节;期间按用户语言回复,并把学到的持久信息写入记忆。
howto.when: 在 omo 新用户的第一次对话中自动启动一次;之后可随时用 `senpi --onboard` 参数重新唤回引导。

say.text: 可以看看我以前的编码会话,分析我的工作方式。
say.note: 触发会话考古,挖掘历史。

say.text: 我从 Claude Code 转过来,想迁移原有配置。
say.note: 进入迁移帮助,会检查本机并给出计划。

say.text: 给我介绍一下 omo 有哪些功能吧。
say.note: 展开功能导览,分批介绍亮点。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a guided tour for a new omo user's first session: feature tour, migration help, session archaeology, value mapping, memory recording, and init-deep proposal; speaks the user's language and records durable facts to memory.
howto.when_en: Auto-starts once, on the first conversation a new omo user has; can be recalled any time with `senpi --onboard`.

say_en.text: You may look through my previous coding sessions and analyze how I work.
say_en.note: Triggers session archaeology and mines history.

say_en.text: I'm coming from Claude Code and would like my setup migrated.
say_en.note: Starts migration help and shows a plan.

say_en.text: Give me an overview of what omo adds.
say_en.note: Runs the feature tour in chunks.
